name: Custom Classes
description: Adds or removes CSS classes on form elements based on route, path or form ID, configured from the UI without a custom hook_form_alter().
project_description: Adds or removes CSS classes on form elements based on the route name, the current URL/path, and/or the form ID — all configured from an admin settings page instead of writing a custom hook_form_alter(). For example, if a module doesn't put a unique class on a button, you can add one; you can also strip classes added by other modules. Rules are entered as semicolon-separated lines (route;url;form_id;$form[...] element path;classes to add;classes to remove). Class removal is a last resort during styling: removing a class that a form's JavaScript/AJAX relies on (e.g. the Commerce Add to cart submit) can break that form, so it should be used sparingly.
